translate ambiguous business problems and complex analyses into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders
Partner with IT, BI, Data, Operations, Finance, and Business teams to strengthen data infrastructure
create leverage beyond the boundaries of a traditional analytics role
proactively identifying opportunities to improve workflows, automate repetitive work, and build scalable solutions
the best analysts increasingly operate like "one-person teams," combining analytical rigor, technical fluency, business judgment, and creativity

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is core analytics plus data-engineering-adjacent ownership: 'Own and improve core data models and pipelines, using tools such as dbt' alongside dashboards, SQL deep dives, and statistical analysis for GTM leadership. It is an analytics business-partner seat, not an agent-building or platform engineering role.
notes: JD is unusually AI-forward for an analyst role ('highly motivated, AI-forward individual', 'Use AI and modern analytical tools to increase the speed, quality, and scope of your work') — the tailored resume should foreground Kanu's AI/automation builds as analyst leverage, not just BI work. Constraints: NYC-based only, no visa sponsorship, application deadline 07/10/2026 (one week out), $125K–$172K base. This maps directly to Kanu's current Walmart Data Ventures senior-analyst profile; dbt/BigQuery/Looker named as plus-not-required.
